tools.name: nolt_get_board
tools.description: Get the feedback board that the API key belongs to: id, name, description, locale, roadmap flag and team members. Good first call. Nolt GraphQL query: board.

tools.name: nolt_list_users
tools.description: List all users of the board with name, SSO id, SSO type and whether the user is an API user. Email addresses are not returned. Nolt GraphQL query: users.

tools.name: nolt_get_user
tools.description: Get one board user by SSO id: name, bio, SSO type and API-user flag. Email addresses are not returned. Nolt GraphQL query: user.

tools.name: nolt_list_statuses
tools.description: List the board's post statuses (custom and system) with id, name, colour and type. Use these to read post status. Nolt GraphQL query: listStatuses.

tools.name: nolt_list_posts
tools.description: List feedback posts on the board, with optional sort (TRENDING, TOP, NEWEST, COMPLETED) and filters. Filter by status or custom field. Returns vote and comment counts. Nolt GraphQL query: posts.

tools.name: nolt_get_post
tools.description: Get one post by id: title, excerpt, status, counts, board and a page of its comments. Use nolt_list_post_votes for votes. Nolt GraphQL query: post.

tools.name: nolt_search_posts
tools.description: Search posts on the board by text, with ordering and paging. Returns matches with counts and the total hit count. Nolt GraphQL query: searchPosts.

tools.name: nolt_list_post_votes
tools.description: List the votes of one post (UP, DOWN or CANCEL) with paging. Returns no votes when the board keeps its voters private. Nolt GraphQL query: post.votes.

tools.name: nolt_get_comment
tools.description: Get one comment by id: text, author, like count and the post it belongs to. Nolt GraphQL query: comment.

tools.name: nolt_list_changelogs
tools.description: List changelog entries of the board. Published entries return for any key; drafts need an owner, admin or moderator SSO identity. Nolt GraphQL query: changelogs.

tools.name: nolt_create_post
tools.description: Publish a new feedback post on the board as the acting SSO user. The post is public if the board is public. Needs a write-enabled API key. Nolt GraphQL mutation: createPost.

tools.name: nolt_create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a post as the acting SSO user. Needs a write-enabled API key. Nolt GraphQL mutation: createComment.

tools.name: nolt_vote_post
tools.description: Set the acting SSO user's vote on a post: UP, DOWN, or CANCEL to remove it. Repeating the same call changes nothing. Needs a write-enabled API key. Nolt GraphQL mutation: votePost.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nolt_list_users, nolt_get_user, nolt_list_statuses, nolt_list_posts, nolt_get_post, nolt_search_posts, nolt_list_post_votes, nolt_get_comment · Private data: nolt_get_board, nolt_list_post_votes, nolt_create_post, nolt_create_comment, nolt_vote_post · Public sink: nolt_list_users, nolt_get_user, nolt_list_statuses, nolt_get_post, nolt_list_post_votes, nolt_get_comment, nolt_create_post, nolt_create_comment, nolt_vote_post · Destructive: nolt_vote_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nolt_list_users, nolt_get_user, nolt_list_statuses, nolt_list_posts, nolt_get_post, nolt_search_posts, nolt_list_post_votes, nolt_get_comment · Private data: nolt_get_board, nolt_list_post_votes, nolt_create_post, nolt_create_comment, nolt_vote_post · Public sink: nolt_list_users, nolt_get_user, nolt_list_statuses, nolt_get_post, nolt_list_post_votes, nolt_get_comment, nolt_create_post, nolt_create_comment, nolt_vote_post · Destructive: nolt_vote_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
